meta.name: How to install Deadlock mods
meta.title: How to Install Deadlock Mods (2026 Guide) | Deadlock Mod Manager
meta.description: How to mod Deadlock step by step: install mods from GameBanana in one click with Deadlock Mod Manager, or by hand with the addons folder and gameinfo.gi.

howTo.question: How do I mod Deadlock?
howTo.answer: Install Deadlock Mod Manager, let it find your game, then download mods from the Mods Store and hit Launch modded. The app handles the addons folder and gameinfo.gi for you.

addonsFolder.question: Where is the Deadlock addons folder?
addonsFolder.answer: Inside your Deadlock install at game/citadel/addons. On Windows that's usually C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Deadlock\game\citadel\addons. Create the addons folder if it doesn't exist.

gameinfo.question: Why do I need to edit gameinfo.gi?
gameinfo.answer: Deadlock only loads files from the addons folder when gameinfo.gi lists it as a search path. Without that line the game ignores your mods. Deadlock Mod Manager adds it when you launch modded.

uninstall.question: How do I uninstall Deadlock mods?
uninstall.answer: In the app, remove mods from the Mods Library, or use Clear All Mods in Settings. To play without mods temporarily, choose Launch without mods. By hand, delete the .vpk files from the addons folder.

linux.question: Can I install Deadlock mods on Linux or Steam Deck?
linux.answer: Yes. Deadlock Mod Manager runs on Linux, including Steam Deck in Desktop Mode, and is available from our APT repository, as a .deb, RPM or Flatpak, on the AUR and in nixpkgs.

hero.title: How to install Deadlock mods
hero.intro: Two ways to mod Deadlock: let Deadlock Mod Manager handle it in a couple of clicks, or set up the addons folder by hand. Both work; the app also keeps your mods updated and easy to undo.

app.title: Install mods with Deadlock Mod Manager
app.intro: The fastest way, and the one we recommend. Takes about two minutes the first time.

download.title: Download the app
download.body: Get it from the <link>download page</link>. Windows builds come with a signed installer; Linux has an APT repository plus .deb, RPM, Flatpak, AUR and nixpkgs packages.

detect.title: Let it find Deadlock
detect.body: The app detects your Steam install. If you keep Deadlock in another library, set the folder in Settings.

pick.title: Pick mods
pick.body: Open the Mods Store, search or filter by hero and category, and click Download.

launch.title: Launch modded
launch.body: Hit Launch modded. The app enables your mods and sets up gameinfo.gi before the game starts.

figure.alt: The Launch modded button in Deadlock Mod Manager with installed mods listed
figure.caption: One button applies your mods and starts Deadlock.

manual.title: Install mods manually
manual.intro: If you'd rather not use a mod manager, this is what it does for you.

steps.extract: Download a mod from GameBanana and extract the archive. You need the .vpk file inside, usually named like pak01_dir.vpk.
steps.addons: Open your Deadlock folder and go to game/citadel. Create an addons folder there if it doesn't exist.
steps.copy: Copy the .vpk into game/citadel/addons. Each mod needs its own number, so rename files that clash: pak01_dir.vpk, pak02_dir.vpk, and so on. When two mods change the same file, the number decides which one loads.
steps.gameinfo: Open game/citadel/gameinfo.gi in a text editor. In the SearchPaths block, add these two lines right above Write citadel:
steps.launch: Save the file and start Deadlock. Steam's "Verify integrity of game files" and some game updates reset gameinfo.gi, so you'll need to add the lines again after those.

manual.outro: That last step is the usual reason mods "stop working" after a patch. The app re-applies it every time you launch modded, and can remove it when you quit so launching from Steam stays vanilla.

after.title: After installing
after.conflicts: Conflicts: two mods that change the same files can't both win. The app warns you and lets you change the load order.
after.updates: Updates: check for mod updates from the Mods Library after a Deadlock patch.
after.profiles: Profiles: keep separate setups (say, a skins-only profile) and share them with friends using a Profile ID.
after.docs: More detail lives in the <link>getting started docs</link>.

downloadBand.title: Skip the manual steps
downloadBand.body: Deadlock Mod Manager does all of this for you, and undoes it just as easily. Free and open source.
